opportunities.title: Main Grants

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based organisations with formal employment or contractual relationship to the host institution; projects must be led by an affiliated individual and not by schools, colleges, undergraduates or PhD students; applicants must be based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: The Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund) supports research addressing priority questions from the Foundation’s Strategic Review, with awards up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based individuals and organisations, with encouragement for applicants from racially minoritised communities and partnership proposals that involve those communities.
opportunities.summary: The Racial Diversity UK Fund supports research on racial diversity within the UK, with grants ranging from £15,000 to £500,000, focusing on inter‑generational changes and challenges in a racially diverse society.
